title: Hearty Oat Porridge with Cheese Crust
description: A comforting and filling oat porridge topped with a crispy cheese crust, perfect for a cold morning.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine oats, water, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the oats are creamy and the water has been absorbed.
In a small bowl, mix together grated cheese and flour.
Once the oats are cooked, remove from heat and stir in butter until melted.
Transfer the oat mixture to a baking dish or individual ramekins.
Top each serving with a sprinkle of the cheese mixture.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and crispy.
